detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Proposal: Establishing Limits of Obedience
detail.summary: This cycle parks the 'Epistemic Independence in Consensus' project to free capacity for investigating the structural limits of rational obedience in autonomous systems. Research focuses on the tension between directive compliance and epistemic independence.
